scope: Major-events accordion behavior and CPO-related public-policy tracker for United States, China, Japan, Korea and Europe
uiChanges: Renamed CPO event panel to 주요 행사 일정.
기업 IR / 발표, 국내, 국외 and 정책 buttons are all inactive on initial load.
The panel shows no schedule cards until a button is selected; selecting a button shows only that category, and selecting it again closes the category.
Added 정책 with country subfilters: 전체, 미국, 중국, 일본, 한국, 유럽.
Policy entries distinguish direct CPO measures from CPO-enabling photonics / advanced-packaging / optical-infrastructure policy.

policies.title: CHIPS NAPMP advanced packaging final awards
policies.note: $1.4B final awards for advanced packaging; includes AI/HPC/data-center substrates, ASU photonics core facility and pilot-line capability. Not a CPO-only program.

policies.title: CHIPS incentives for photonic IC manufacturing and packaging
policies.note: Supports Infinera InP PIC manufacturing/test/packaging and GlobalFoundries photonic-IC advanced packaging. Not a CPO-only program.

policies.title: 电子信息制造业2025－2026年稳增长行动方案
policies.source: MIIT / State Administration for Market Regulation
policies.note: Explicitly calls for increased R&D investment in high-speed optical chips and 光电共封, and integration of optical and electrical architecture ecosystems.

policies.title: Green Innovation Fund — next-generation green data center / photonics-electronics convergence
policies.note: Project includes CPO application technology, multimode CPO module technology and single-mode CPO transmission technology in optical smart NIC R&D.

policies.title: 차세대광기반연산반도체핵심기술개발사업
policies.note: New 2026 R&D program for optical-computing semiconductor core technologies alongside advanced-packaging R&D; not a CPO-only program.

policies.title: AI 시대 통신인프라 투자 촉진 민·관협의체
policies.note: Includes AIDC and optical communications in next-generation communications infrastructure and plans an investment/regulatory improvement package.

policies.title: PIXEurope Advanced Photonic Integrated Circuits Pilot Line
policies.note: Open-access advanced PIC pilot line covering fabrication, integration, packaging, testing and scaling; relevant enabling infrastructure rather than a CPO-only policy.
